title.narrative: Roadmap to Durable Solutions: Strengthening the Government of Colombia in the implementation of the Durable Solutions Strategy

description.narrative:
In response to the persistent internal displacement in Colombia and in line with Law 1448/2011, the guidelines set forth by the Constitutional Court (Decision T-025/2004), IASC’s global framework for durable solutions, and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), this project will assist the Colombian government in formulating and implementing a Durable Solutions Strategy until 2031. The proposal is organized into four temporal horizons:
First Horizon (until December 2023): Consolidate the partnership between the UN System and the National Government with a general definition of the strategy’s policy and concept, which highlights urban housing, habitat, and access to rural lands as key elements of a durable solution.
Second Horizon (year 2024): Early implementation with an emphasis on neighborhood improvement, housing, and territorial development plans. Institutional adjustments and coordination for an effective intervention.
Third Horizon (between 2025 and 2026): Consolidate institutional adjustments and enhance implementation actions.
Fourth Horizon (between 2026 and 2031): Consolidate and adjust the strategy based on changing dynamics and needs.
The Joint Programme (JP) plans to implement actions for 18 months (2024-2025) to support institutional agreements, provide technical information, overcome barriers in program coordination, estimate realistic costs, and propose financing alternatives. The JP will be implemented by UNHCR, UNDP, IOM, and UN-Habitat, in coordination with the SD Advisor of the OCR.
This proposal not only aims to address internal displacement but also to significantly contribute to the social transformations outlined in the National Development Plan. Collaboration between the Government and the United Nations system in Colombia is essential for the formulation and effective implementation of the Durable Solutions Strategy.
